findings.text: The company's status is recorded as dissolved, and it ceased on 8 April 2014.
The company was incorporated on 20 March 2013 and ceased 1.1 years (384 days) later.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
No charges are registered against the company.
The company has one current officer, a director, PERSON 366, appointed 20 March 2013.
No current person with significant control is on record, although this does not prove the company has no owner.
The accounts and confirmation statement have unknown overdue status, with no next due date or last made-up date recorded.
PERSON 366 has no other appointments on record, and no other companies were found across the one current director checked.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 469 (91000470) is dissolved, having ceased on 8 April 2014, with no insolvency record, no registered charges and one current director on record.
